acceptanceCriteria: Renderer and findings log exist; after 40 PRs the confirmed-finding rate per arm is recorded with an interval in a build-log entry.
body:
Panel finding (outcome lens). Today nothing consumes a cem/1.0 map's citation block: CI has no dogfood-check or verify step, Tasks consumes no CEM (0525:95, V1-1283 not started), the dashboard adapter accepts only 0.1/0.2, cem-trial refuses 1.0 treatment arms (cem-reviewer-trial-v0.md:266-277), and the only outcome evidence is the 2026-09-04 pilot with an all-unknown cem/0.1 arm (decision 0427 finding 1: uninformative). V1-0836/V1-0838 (three-arm trial, human leg) are NOT_RUN.
Cheapest load-bearing integration: on alternating PRs give the Codex review lane a projection ordered unknown / self-only / anchor-less first with path:lines and a quoted span; log every finding and whether a later fix confirms it; ~40 PRs over 4 weeks. Raise: higher confirmed-finding rate with the map. Kill: no difference. V1-1283 alone gates on ACCEPT, which the dogfood loop already guarantees (DOGFOOD.md:175), so it binds the map without changing an outcome unless it applies a policy over the citation block.

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
title: Make the map load-bearing: feed the resolved citation projection into the independent review lane on alternating PRs and log confirmed findings
